_comment: Single-corner READER PROBE for issue #1028's AC 2 reconciliation (part of #486). It is not a
qualification receipt and changes no gate: it prints, verbatim, what OpenSTA's reader kept for the
eleven aliased timed nets when it reads the qualified SPEF, because the November receipts retain
only a 20-entry sample of the reader's partially-unannotated-driver listing (klt caps the sample),
'780bae77' in the record id names the main commit whose committed DEF, SPEF and TT request were read;
the probe ran on host tools, not the pinned klt 0.8.0, and its numbers are cited only where they are
reader accounting, never as timing evidence. Timing evidence stays the two November receipts.
openroad: run from the repo root with the PDK installed (docs/environment-setup.md),
The OPENROAD_* names pass through the Docker wrapper; the script mirrors the design-loading
steps of the klt-generated sta_sar_ctrl.tcl (LEF, DEF, Liberty, create_clock 62.5 ns, read_spef),
then reports parasitic annotation and each net.
klt_sta_rerun: the committed TT SPEF request, run unchanged through the host klt, to confirm the
hand-written script leaves the reader in the state klt's own generated script does.

klt_sta_rerun.command: PDK_ROOT=$HOME/.ciel PDK=gf180mcuD klt sta <request> --pdk gf180mcuD --format json
